title: CI Verdict v1
description: Canonical CI verdict produced by the CI evidence orchestrator. Evaluates CI evidence coherence: artifact presence, schema validation, hash verification, and runner class consistency. Consumed by the release gate validator.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for the parent CI run.

verdict.description: CI evidence verdict. pass: all evidence coherent and verifiable. hold: evidence present but some assertions unverified. fail: evidence missing, malformed, or contradictory.

release_gate_blocker_id.description: The release gate blocker this verdict evaluates.

runner_class.description: CI/CD runner classification at verdict time.

official_release.description: True only for official release CI runs.

release_class.description: Release classification for this CI run.

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this verdict was evaluated.

required_artifacts_present.description: True if all required artifacts (ci_run, ci_job, artifact_index, verdict) are present and parseable.

required_artifacts_valid.description: True if all required artifacts validate against their schemas.

artifact_hashes_verified.description: True if all artifact SHA-256 digests match the referenced file contents.

schema_validation_summary.description: Summary of schema validation results for CI evidence artifacts.

test_receipt_summary.description: Summary of test receipt presence and validity.

release_bundle_manifest_summary.description: Summary of release bundle manifest presence and validity.

blocking_reasons.description: Reasons the verdict is hold or fail. Empty for pass.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings about evidence quality or missing non-required artifacts.

evidence_paths.description: Relative paths from repo root to all evidence artifacts referenced by this verdict.

telemetry_redaction_notes.description: Statement that no raw secrets, credentials, private file contents, raw prompts, or private repository contents were emitted in this evidence.
